newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate jumps in wake of peso tumble.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate jumps in wake of peso tumble.

text.p: Mexico's overnight Cetes rate opened sharply up on Wednesday following a low close on Tuesday and another speculative onslaught against the peso, traders said.

The overnight Cetes rate was up 190 basis points at 26.65 percent, traders said, adding the upward trend in primary rates set at Tuesday evening's primary auction appeared to be insufficient to stabilize the peso.
"We're returning to yesterday's average levels, nonetheless, the peso is not responding as expected," said a trader.
"Primary hikes were less than expected, but the market is still illiquid due to jitters spurred by the stumbling peso," the trader added.
Bellwether 28-day Cetes moved up to yield 25.90 percent, 316 basis points above last week's rates in the primary auction.
The benchmark 48-hour peso was 9.1 centavos down in early trade at 7.80/7.82 per dollar.
Overnight rates on bank paper were meanwhile up 150 basis points at 29 percent.
Total credit maturities were estimated at 6.116 billion pesos for Wednesday.
Traders expected the Cetes overnight rate to continue to rise if pressure on the peso does not abate.
